session._comment: Cost backstop only, across all tasks. max_cycles replaces max_rounds now that cycles are per-task; 96 is ~24 cycles/task.

schedule._ncu_note: Was 1 per ROUND, which was premature: profiling is the highest-value information available and the GPU is idle >90% of the time. Now a concurrency cap, which the lease already enforces anyway. Three of task 01's promotions trace to a profile, and it is step 1 of soft escalation.

guards._checkpoint_note: Round 1 had ~40 min of work uncommitted across three worktrees at one point. 'Commit before exiting' does nothing for a worker that dies mid-cycle; commit at each milestone instead.

escalation._comment: The most common stall is a worker that stopped measuring and started guessing (playbook rule 6). No task should reach 'stalled' without an ncu profile of its current champion.

_comment: Deck-level only: session budget, cross-task scheduling, shared guards. Per-task dials live in <task>/config.json.
